Public  Financial  Management
containing easy-to-understand summary of the main
features of the annual budget;
the  fiscal  strategy  statement  and  the  budget,
economic and fiscal position report;
medium-term  debt  management  strategy  and
annual borrowing plan;
the  list  of  ongoing  and  newly  approved  public
investment  projects,  including  public-private
partnership projects in accordance with subsection
(1) of section 45;
the  list  of  outstanding  loans  and  outstanding
guarantees provided by the Government and other
contingent liabilities of the Government including
those related to public-private partnership projects;
a  summary  of  public  service  employment  across
budgetary  entities;
a statement of tax expenditures including the total
cost of existing tax expenditures and the disclosure
of new tax expenditures; and
any  other  documents  or  information  as  required
under this Act or any other written law or as may
deemed appropriate by the Minister of Finance.
